connectionnotes-desc: The connection box: a visitor's note about an unrecorded connection, saved as text for a person to verify
connectionnote-help: Saves a plain-text note about a connection to Cryptograss talk:Connection inbox. Parameters: about (who it is about), from (where you came from), note (the connection, up to 2000 characters).
apierror-connectionnote-invalid: A field is missing or too long (note: at most $1 characters).
apierror-connectionnote-nouser: The note-writer system user does not exist yet; run update.php.
apierror-connectionnote-notitle: The connection inbox page title is invalid.
